title: 雨停之前
description: 原创双格漫画，用稳定的人设讲一个小故事。
prompt: A complete vertical 2:3 comic page, original quiet urban short story called AFTER THE RAIN. Four carefully paced panels in black ink and pale watercolor, subtle printed paper texture. Top panel spans the page: a narrow Japanese shopping street after a shower, power lines leading into the distance. Second row two small panels: a hand opening a clear umbrella; rain droplets on a vending machine. Bottom large panel: a young adult cyclist in a mustard raincoat rides away beneath a glowing shop awning, seen from behind. The vertical page creates a readable top-to-bottom narrative with thin ivory gutters. Cinematic perspective, beautifully observed everyday objects, indigo shadows, tiny vermilion accents. Only text is the small English title AFTER THE RAIN in the upper margin, no speech bubbles, no random lettering, no existing characters, no watermark.

title: 一口夏日
description: 真实产品与涂鸦结合，适合饮品品牌广告。
prompt: A sophisticated creative advertising still life on a warm ivory background. A realistic unbranded chilled orange soda can tilted diagonally at the center, vivid orange lacquer, accurate condensation droplets. Combine the physical can with playful thin black hand-drawn doodles: a tiny sun peeks around its rim, a line-drawn wave curls behind it and a small illustrated swimmer dives toward a real orange slice. Sharp studio product photography meets minimal ink illustration. One crisp headline at top left reading exactly "SQUEEZE THE DAY" in confident black condensed sans serif. Restrained composition with large breathing room, rich natural citrus textures, subtle contact shadows, polished editorial art direction. No other text, no logo, no watermark, no fake nutrition claims.

title: 开往夏夜的列车
description: 复古动画电影海报，电影光影与旧纸质感。
prompt: Original hand-painted anime film still in a wide 3:2 landscape frame. A tiny turquoise local train moves left to right across a low coastal viaduct, summer twilight, a vast lavender sea and peach cloud horizon fill the width of the scene. Foreground on the right: two small adult travelers waiting at a quiet open platform, bicycle leaning against the rail. Distant island lights, delicate overhead wires, gentle wind in tall grasses. The panoramic horizon and lateral movement are essential; create visual space ahead of the train, not a centered portrait poster. Detailed gouache backgrounds, fine hand-drawn animation linework, nostalgic film grain, poetic calm. Original world and characters. No text, no logos, no watermark.

title: 玻璃引力
description: 玻璃材质、折射和色散的三维视觉研究。
prompt: Photorealistic high-end 3D art object: a sculptural transparent glass torus bent into an elegant asymmetrical orbital knot, suspended in a pale icy blue studio. Thick optical glass with iridescent blue, lilac and cyan edge highlights, physically convincing refraction and subtle spectral dispersion. Studio HDRI, angled top-left large softbox, narrow rim light, caustic reflections falling onto the smooth matte floor. Object fills seventy percent of square frame with generous margins, visually precise silhouette, translucent clean center, tiny realistic imperfections only. Contemporary collectible design object photographed for an art publication. No text, no logo, no extra objects, no watermark, no excessive bloom.

title: 木版画里的未来
description: 把现代交通转译成江户浮世绘的未来想象。
prompt: A vertical 2:3 contemporary Japanese woodblock print on warm handmade paper. A tall vermilion shrine gate frames a narrow street rising uphill in modern Kyoto; a tiny mint electric scooter and one adult with a translucent umbrella near the bottom, utility cables and roof tiles lead upward through successive planes to a huge pale apricot moon near the top. Strong vertical architecture and stacked landscape depth. Indigo, dusty coral, sage and cream, carved ink outlines, deliberate flat color fields, subtle misregistration and visible washi fibers. Small decorative unlettered cartouche; no fake Japanese writing, no words, no watermark. Carefully balanced asymmetry, gallery-quality print, full composition with breathing margins.

title: 丝绸的另一种形状
description: 用褶皱与光泽，把抽象形态变成可触摸的物体。
prompt: An elegant surreal 3D sculpture of a blooming five-petal flower made entirely of flowing burnt-orange silk. The continuous silk surface forms soft inflated petals, intricate believable fabric folds, a gently curled central opening and beautiful woven microtexture. It floats slightly above a clean warm pale gray background. Gallery-quality studio lighting with soft highlights, rich natural shadows in folds, subtle contact shadow below. Contemporary tactile design, refined luxury fashion campaign mood, minimal square composition with large negative space. Make the shape read clearly as a sculptural flower rather than a realistic plant. No vase, no leaves, no text, no logo, no watermark.

title: 光落在沉默之间
description: 黑白肖像，定向光与留白塑造人物情绪。
prompt: Vertical 2:3 black-and-white editorial portrait of an adult East Asian woman with a short softly disheveled bob and a black turtleneck. Three-quarter head and shoulders, one hand resting lightly against the collarbone, eyes looking past the camera. A tall strip of window light falls diagonally across the face, deep velvety charcoal backdrop. Frame includes space above the hair and the full hand below, naturally elongated portrait composition. Medium-format photographic realism, delicate silver-gelatin grain, authentic skin pores, nuanced highlights on cheekbone, sculptural shadows, restrained intimate mood. No plastic skin, no glamour retouching, no text, no watermark.

title: 一座掌心夜市
description: 微缩城市与移轴镜头，制作有叙事细节的空间。
prompt: An ultra-detailed miniature cyberpunk night market viewed from above at a three-quarter angle, beautifully crafted as a tiny architectural diorama on a dark square plinth. Narrow rain-wet alleys, turquoise and coral neon light strips, tiny steaming noodle stalls, pocket-sized commuters carrying clear umbrellas, potted plants and tangled cables. One little delivery robot waits politely behind a cat. High resolution cinematic CG, convincing handcrafted scale model materials, dramatic but readable lighting, tilt-shift macro depth of field, crisp central area and softly blurred edges. Rich teal, warm amber and small pink highlights, realistic reflections, sophisticated visual storytelling. No readable lettering, no brands, no watermark.

title: 春茶的层次
description: 以纵向产品叙事串联茶罐、茶叶与冲泡细节的编辑式海报。
prompt: Create a sophisticated vertical 2:3 tea product editorial poster, warm ivory paper, forest green accents. Top: generous small headline exactly SPRING TEA in a refined serif. Main upper-middle photograph: a beautiful unbranded celadon tea tin with its lid slightly lifted, loose tea leaves suspended in a vertical cascade above a shallow handmade ceramic cup, a single branch of fresh leaves; soft morning window light, realistic glaze and paper packaging. Lower third: two small photographic detail windows side by side, one macro of dried tea leaves, one of amber tea being poured. Delicate rules and generous margins join the sections into a coherent product story, not a random collage. Tiny captions exactly LEAF and BREW. No invented claims, no additional text, no existing brand, no watermark. Premium print art direction, natural botanical palette, perfectly legible restrained typography.

title: 城市的另一面
description: 旅行主题图形海报，构图、色块与文字一起设计。
prompt: Create an elegant vertical travel poster, portrait 2:3. A golden yellow tram on a steep sunlit street in Lisbon. Stacked coral buildings, blue ceramic tiled facades, distant turquoise river. Carefully composed tall street perspective, strong graphic shapes, warm cream sky. Large serif title LISBON at the top, small PORTUGAL below. Limited screenprint palette of terracotta, golden yellow, navy blue and ivory, fine paper grain. Generous margins and refined graphic design. Entire scene composed for a tall print. No extra lettering, no watermark, no logos.

title: 纸上的秘密花园
description: 层层剪纸与真实纸纤维，适合节庆和品牌插画。
prompt: A museum-quality handcrafted layered paper-cut illustration of a secret botanical garden inside a large circular window. Curling fern fronds, oversized coral poppies, pale yellow flowers, navy leaves, a tiny cream bird perched on a branch. Each element cut from matte colored paper with visible fibers, clean hand-cut edges and delicate folds. Eight distinct layers create real physical depth with soft cast shadows between them. Rich forest green, muted coral, ochre and warm cream palette on a deep green backdrop, soft angled studio light, refined symmetrical outer structure with organic inner rhythm. Square composition, tactile and sophisticated, intricate without clutter. No text, no logo, no watermark.

title: 一件春天的衣服
description: 时尚封面：花卉、面料与杂志字体的平衡。
prompt: Vertical 2:3 independent fashion magazine cover, full-length editorial photograph of an adult woman wearing a sculptural ivory pleated gown with oversized pale pink petal-like shoulder folds. She stands slightly off center with one leg forward in a tall pale stone doorway; the complete dress hem and both shoes visible, ample space above her head. Her dark hair in a sleek low bun, calm confident expression, natural skin and anatomy. Side daylight reveals translucent organza layers and fine fabric texture, soft dusty rose shadows, sophisticated 85mm fashion photography. Masthead exactly PETAL at the top in large refined black serif letters; a small line exactly FORM / LIGHT / MOTION at the bottom. No other cover lines, no existing brand, no watermark.

title: 把海装进口袋
description: 超现实冰棒，以微缩场景创造记忆点。
prompt: A horizontal 3:2 surreal premium summer product advertisement: one crystal-clear pale cyan ice pop lies diagonally from lower left toward upper right above a broad turquoise tidal pool. Inside the ice are tiny suspended bubbles, a delicate miniature reef and a single tiny orange fish. A realistic wooden stick extends toward the left with room around its end. Wide water caustics run across the entire background, sunlight refracts through melting ice, small droplets and shallow ripples, restrained coral accent. Overhead macro product photography combined with a believable miniature underwater world, crisp glassy edges, refreshing negative space across the wide composition. No text, no logos, no watermark.

title: 云端咖啡馆
description: 把杯子变成建筑，可复用到门店与 IP 场景。
prompt: An original architectural miniature in a wide 3:2 landscape frame: a low elongated glass-and-walnut cafe pavilion floating on a soft cloud island at sunrise. A long open terrace extends horizontally with a row of tiny chairs and a few potted olive trees, one tiny adult reading at the far right, warm interior lights and a curved espresso counter visible through the glass. Broad lavender sky, peach sun off to the left, airy clouds stretching behind the building. The low horizontal silhouette and generous surrounding sky are essential. Meticulous collectible architectural maquette, matte clay terrain, realistic glazing and warm timber details, soft atmospheric shadows, tasteful cinematic lighting. No signs, no words, no logo, no watermark.

title: 黄铜游梦
description: 齿轮、玻璃和金属结构组成的机械生物设计。
prompt: An exquisite steampunk mechanical fish, entire body visible in side profile facing right, floating centrally against a warm pale stone studio backdrop. Its body consists of polished aged brass armor with open sections exposing intricate interlocking functional gears, tiny screws and elegant clockwork linkages. Translucent amber glass fins containing tiny air bubbles; tail fin woven from fine metal wires. Faceted dark ruby eye with precise reflections. Beautifully crafted plausible mechanical anatomy, refined jewelry photography lighting, sharp focus throughout the fish, subtle background gear shadow and plenty of negative space. Luminous rather than dark, high detail and distinctive tactile materials. No lettering on the body, no signature, no watermark.

title: 山河在心里
description: 双重曝光，把人物剪影和风景编织成一幅画。
prompt: A vertical 2:3 fine-art double-exposure portrait. A single clean side-profile silhouette of an adult woman looking left, from crown to upper chest, on softly textured warm ivory paper. Inside her silhouette, tall dark cedar trees rise from the shoulders toward the crown; a narrow white waterfall descends through mist down the neck, and one tiny rust-red cabin at the base provides scale. The forest follows the elongated portrait shape naturally, never spills out as random decoration. Subtle translucent facial features and beautifully controlled blended photographic exposures, deep emerald, fog gray and one warm accent. Strong readable silhouette, contemplative atmosphere, no text, no watermark.

title: 月亮也需要晚安
description: 童话叙事插画，用色彩和光线建立自己的世界。
prompt: A wide 3:2 children's picture-book spread without text. A small original child astronaut in a soft cream spacesuit sits at the far left on the curve of a tiny blue moon, gently casting a fishing line across the wide midnight sky to a sleepy glowing golden star on the right. Between them stretches quiet indigo negative space sprinkled with a few tiny painted stars. A little kettle and folded blanket beside the astronaut, rounded shapes, tender storytelling, delicate gouache and pencil texture on thick paper. Wide left-to-right visual conversation is essential, rich ultramarine, soft butter yellow and muted coral accents. Sophisticated whimsical illustration, no famous characters, no letters, no watermark.

title: 口袋里的小伙伴
description: 针织 IP 形象，保留毛线的真实手工触感。
prompt: An intimate expertly composed macro photograph of a tiny handmade crochet fox sitting in a gentle pair of adult hands. Rounded orange wool body, oversized cream ears, a sage green knitted scarf, two small black stitched eyes and tiny carefully crafted paws. Every yarn loop clearly visible, subtle fuzzy fibers, wonderful handcrafted imperfection. Hands with realistic anatomy and natural skin texture cradle the fox carefully. Warm timber studio table and softly blurred plant in the background, gentle window sunlight, shallow depth of field, cozy but sophisticated craft editorial photography. Warm orange, cream and sage palette, square composition, full toy visible. No text, no logo, no watermark.

title: 午夜之后的线索
description: 统一角色与场景的电影分镜，适合短篇故事规划。
prompt: A beautifully composed square four-panel cinematic noir storyboard with clean thin black gutters, no captions. Tell a complete mysterious visual story with the same original adult woman detective in a tan trench coat and short dark bob in all four panels. Top left: wide establishing shot of a rain-soaked art deco station at midnight. Top right: close-up of her hand finding a tiny brass key inside a red envelope. Bottom left: she opens a dark blue locker with warm light emerging, dramatic over-shoulder angle. Bottom right: inside is a miniature luminous garden with a small white moth flying toward her, reflected in her surprised face. Consistent costume and face, painterly cinematic concept art, dramatic teal and amber lighting, crisp visual storytelling and atmospheric depth, realistic proportions. No speech bubbles, no letters, no watermark.

title: 声音的柔软形状
description: 柔和 3D 广告，让产品和抽象场景形成统一语言。
prompt: A vertical 2:3 premium playful audio product campaign poster. Sculptural over-ear headphones made of soft butter-yellow matte material, suspended in the upper half with the arch fully visible. A lilac ribbon of sound curls downward through the ear cups toward a tiny mint pedestal in the lower half, making an elegant tall S-shaped visual path. Pale warm pink studio, gentle ambient shadows, tactile clay-like surfaces, precise 3D product rendering. Generous margins and refined art direction. At the bottom, small tasteful dark plum serif words exactly SOFT SOUND, with a short thin rule above. No other text, no brand logos, no watermark, no busy confetti.
